description_en: Pre-validates a video character replacement task
description_zh: 预校验视频人物替换任务
name: PrecheckVideoCharacterReplaceJob

parameters.help_en: The ID of the video character replacement application. Use a configured application
parameters.help_zh: 视频人物替换应用 ID。请使用已配置的应用
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The application input parameters, which are provided as a JSON-serialized string. The field names and material requirements are subject to the input definition of the corresponding AppId
parameters.help_zh: 应用输入参数，JSON 序列化后的字符串。字段名和素材要求以对应 AppId 的输入定义为准
parameters.name: app_params

schema.description_en: The response returned when the request is successful
schema.description_zh: 请求成功时的返回结果

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used to locate and troubleshoot the request
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于定位和排查请求

Result.description_en: The list of items that failed the validation. This is an empty array if the validation passes
Result.description_zh: 校验失败项列表；校验通过时为空数组

ErrorCode.description_en: The validation error code for the input item. For example, ImageCheckFailed indicates that the image validation failed, and AudioCheckFailed indicates that the audio validation failed
ErrorCode.description_zh: 该输入项的校验错误码，例如 ImageCheckFailed 表示图片校验失败，AudioCheckFailed 表示音频校验失败

Key.description_en: The name of the input parameter that failed the validation, which matches the corresponding field name in AppParams
Key.description_zh: 校验失败的输入参数名，与 AppParams 中对应的字段名一致

Status.description_en: The pre-validation status. A value of Success indicates that the validation passed. A value of Failed indicates that one or more items failed the validation
Status.description_zh: 预校验状态：Success 表示校验通过，Failed 表示存在校验失败项
